brief:
Former activists with US Palestine Action face potential contempt of court charges after refusing to testify before a federal Grand Jury, Middle East Eye reported. The investigation reportedly centers on US activist Fergie Chambers' extradition case, though additional details about the scope and subjects of the Grand Jury inquiry remain unclear.

The activists' refusal to cooperate with the Grand Jury proceeding could result in legal sanctions, including fines or jail time for contempt. The exact circumstances prompting the Grand Jury investigation and the activists' stated reasons for declining to testify were not specified.

title: Former US activists face contempt charges for refusing Grand Jury testimony
